observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 30 stand in the right margin and the locator «p. 226.» (L9) in the left margin; in the locator the 2s are printed blotted. The count of the lines runs through the spaces and the heads of G and H: 5 stands beside the first line of the title of G, 20 beside the head H, where only its 0 is printed.

body L1-L4, L14-L15: the heads G and H are set in a larger bold type and centred; the title of G is set in a larger type as a paragraph whose second and third lines are indented, the title of H in a larger type, centred.
body: a tailpiece closes the translation below the notes: a rule swelling into three lenses in the middle; it is redrawn from the print (figures/AB01-PDF0239-F01.tex).
body L22: the s of «respectu» is printed small and raised.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
